phase_scope: Adversarial release hardening only: converge proof validation and publication, reconcile the installed consumer/error/CI surface, then independently requalify one exact private candidate.
active_objective: Build and retain one exact private candidate from a clean commit, run the full source-free hostile corpus against those bytes, and assign three fresh isolated reviewers to attack artifact/distribution, evidence/proof, and runtime/containment boundaries. Require each reviewer to issue a structured ACCEPT with no critical, high, or medium finding before closeout.
non_goals: No npm publication, GitHub Release, repository visibility change, deployment, customer use, public announcement, certification, or trademark claim
No new product feature, provider integration, command, export, schema, assurance level, effect category, trust policy, or verification primitive
No weakening or removal of consumer bins, exports, verifier capability, known-failing fixtures, hostile corpus cases, or independently useful free functionality
No rewrite of historical S10-S12 evidence
No credential value, credential screenshot, or rotation secret in any retained file
No false claim that reviewer agreement is provider attestation, production certification, or permission to publish
No hardening-queue closeout while credential rotation is unconfirmed
No queue entries outside the authorized Adversarial Release Hardening Macro Delta
